caption:
Bad visa advice: "buy the tickets first, it shows commitment."

It does not. Consulates ask for reservations, not purchases. Buying early adds nothing to your file and puts real money at risk if you are refused or your dates move.

Proper reservations do the job the application actually requires: a real, dated, coherent plan.

alt: Why not to buy flights before visa approval when applying from Dubai

slides.headline: "BUY THE TICKETS FIRST. IT SHOWS COMMITMENT."
slides.sub: It shows nothing. And it costs you.
slides.note: We hear this one constantly. It comes from people who have never had an application refused.

slides.body: Not purchases. A dated, verifiable reservation satisfies the requirement completely.
slides.note: Buying early adds no weight to your file. It only adds exposure.

slides.headline: WHAT THIS ADVICE ACTUALLY COSTS
slides.never: Purchase non-refundable tickets before approval. If the application is refused, or your dates shift during processing, that money is gone — on top of a non-refundable visa fee.
slides.instead: Issue proper reservations that hold for the application period, matched exactly to your itinerary and your cover letter. Nothing is at risk before the decision.

slides.headline: WHAT A RESERVATION MUST DO
items: Cover accommodation for every night of the stay

slides.headline: NEVER GAMBLE AIRFARE ON A DECISION THAT HASN'T HAPPENED.
slides.sub: Reservations are part of every file we build.
